issues.description: Class name mismatch for the concrete Animal implementations: the problem statement (UML and tasks) and the template Main expect concrete classes named Seal, Pig, and Goat, but the solution repository provides implementations named SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat. This divergence means the example Main and the UML-referenced tasks refer to classes (Seal/Pig/Goat) that do not exist in the solution, which will confuse students and prevent direct mapping between the exercise description/template and the provided solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make class names consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution classes SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat to Seal, Pig, and Goat respectively (adjusting constructors and references), or alternatively add Seal/Pig/Goat wrapper classes that delegate to the Space* implementations and update the solution repository so that the class names referenced in the problem statement and template resolve correctly. Ensure the Main example and UML/tasks match the final class names.
